hook: GPT‑6 now serves over 1.2 billion users — plus 4 more

items.claim: GPT‑6 model launched for over 1.2 billion weekly ChatGPT users
Intelligent UI lets ChatGPT generate interactive interfaces instantly
Claude Haiku 5.5 is now available on AWS
Clef‑omni adds full multimodality; Clef‑flash runs cheaper
Asana’s browser agent runs 76 × cheaper and 5 × faster with GPT‑6.1

caption: OpenAI rolls out GPT‑6 to billions, adding an Intelligent UI that builds visual tools on the fly. Meanwhile, Claude Haiku 5.5, Cloudflare’s multimodal Clef‑omni, and Asana’s cheaper, faster browser agent show how AI is becoming more accessible and affordable. Which of these upgrades will you notice first?
alt_text: Five slides on flat colour backgrounds: slide 1 says GPT‑6 model launched for over 1.2 billion weekly ChatGPT users; slide 2 says Intelligent UI lets ChatGPT generate interactive interfaces instantly; slide 3 says Claude Haiku 5.5 is now available on AWS; slide 4 says Clef‑omni adds full multimodality and Clef‑flash runs cheaper; slide 5 says Asana’s browser agent runs 76 × cheaper and 5 × faster with GPT‑6.1.
